name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardExperienceGuideActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user starts a multi-step app-experience reward offer. It explains the experience task and the reward available for completing it.
disableEffect: The multi-step ad-reward task cannot start, and its ad-view rewards will no longer be granted.
